description: Source code for Windows-specific UDP socket implementation in Chromium project, including socket management, overlapped I/O, QoS handling, and network event processing.

classes.name: UDPSocketWin::Core
classes.description: Encapsulates state for asynchronous UDP socket operations, including overlapped I/O and event watching.

classes.name: QwaveApi
classes.description: Handles dynamic loading of QWave QoS DLL functions and provides methods to create and manage QoS handles.

classes.name: DscpManager
classes.description: Manages DSCP settings and QoS flows for a socket, including handle creation and address-specific flow setup.

methods.name: WatchForRead
methods.description: Starts watching for read completion events.

methods.name: WatchForWrite
methods.description: Starts watching for write completion events.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detaches the Core from the socket, used when socket is closing.

methods.name: OnObjectSignaled
methods.description: Handles signaling of overlapped I/O events for read/write operations.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the DSCP value for the socket via QoS handle.

methods.name: PrepareForSend
methods.description: Prepares the socket for sending data with specific DSCP and QoS settings.

methods.name: RequestHandle
methods.description: Initiates creation of a QoS handle asynchronously.
